title: Windows Explorer 自定义命名空间与右侧视图技术验证
risks: UAC/high-integrity 阻断已排除，微软 Shell32 控制组也证明标准用户 Explorer 能发现 HKCU namespace；原始自定义 DLL 仍不被枚举或加载，其受支持的注册/部署兼容路径尚未确定。
HKCU 注册/验证/卸载、直接 COM activation、完整 Shell bind、隔离 view window 和微软控制组真实 Explorer 导航均已验证，但原始自定义 DLL 的 Explorer 视图生命周期与故障隔离仍未验证。
同步 Shell cache 通知曾在控制组窗口打开时阻塞；注册表清理已由只读复核证明完成。3 秒有界通知已通过无窗口回归，但 patched live-window cleanup 仍需一次隔离 VM 复测。
取消后的 overlapped I/O 排空不阻塞 Explorer UI，但其独立时长上限尚未在 Windows 证明。
本地 Spike DLL/host 未签名，只能用于受控验证，不能作为分发产物。
8 小时 soak 尚未执行；当前无稳定性结论。
Spike PIDL、视图和 IPC payload 不能直接升级为生产接口。
blocked_by: 在隔离 VM 复测 patched live-window cleanup，确认最终 Shell 通知即使延迟也在 3 秒后返回 warning，且 owner-guarded 注册表保持 clean
M0-009 需决定 Windows 11 26100 上原始自定义 COM 的受支持且满足 HKCU-only 边界的 Explorer namespace 注册/部署模型；未经批准不得改用 HKLM
按决策后的兼容入口执行原始自定义 Explorer 视图、故障注入和卸载恢复；当前两种官方 CLSID 入口均在加载测试 DLL 前失败
Explorer 内的 250 ms deadline、取消排空、状态恢复与 normal host 重连仍需观察和计时
20 次 crash/restart 与 8 小时 Explorer evidence: 按 docs/spikes/M0-002/explorer-soak-protocol.md 操作，同时 ./tests/spikes/windows-shell/scripts/soak.ps1 -Hours 8 仅作为 host-cycle helper

reused_existing_logic: Windows SDK COM/Shell ABI and C++/WinRT base header
duplicated_logic: None; host ping is intentionally Spike-local and not shared business logic
new_language_or_framework: C++17 + Windows SDK C++/WinRT/COM, limited to this Spike per task package
new_major_dependencies: Validation-only Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools 17.14.39 and Windows SDK 10.0.26100; no third-party runtime or library
architecture_tests: test_contracts.py version/length/timeout, HKCU registration symmetry, bounded background Shell association-cache refresh and cleanup best-effort checks
test_contracts.py single-flight refresh, stale-result token and detached-worker exception-boundary checks
test_contracts.py Windows SDK constant, COM export ABI and build exit-code checks
test_contracts.py UAC-disabled zero-write refusal and official Explorer namespace launch checks
Windows Release x64 build, export-table inspection, isolated host protocol modes and COM factory probe
Watchdog-protected HKCU register/verify/unregister, registered CoCreateInstance and complete Shell folder/item contract probe
Native hidden IShellBrowser probe through CreateViewObject/CreateViewWindow, plus real Explorer launch/enumeration and recovery diagnostics
Isolated-VM Microsoft Shell32 control namespace navigation, read-only cleanup verification, and no-window bounded-notification regression

A Windows 11 26100-compatible custom COM registration/deployment decision, process evidence and 8-hour soak are required before any architecture freeze
Spike-local PIDL/IPC must not become a production contract
